svg.title: Experience
svg.desc: Jun 2024 – now: Assistant System Engineer, Tata Consultancy Services, for UBS. Trainee until June 2025.. Multi-agent AI workflows and Python utilities. An identification agent adopted by 13+ teams, CI/CD changes tied to 40% faster deployments, and Splunk dashboards tied to a 15% drop in downtime. Apr – Jun 2024: Full Stack Engineer, Laptop First. Nov 2022 – Nov 2023: Software Engineering, TCI, client work for HerHeadquarters and Mud Australia.. Stability work on a product with 10,000+ monthly users: 50+ production issues resolved and a reported 30% faster build time. Impact figures are self-reported.
